title: Finite coefficient naturality of the canonical boundary
statement: For n>0, finite commutative A and B killed by n, φ:A→B and effective Cartier i:D→Z with n invertible on Z, the canonical classes [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] satisfy GeoCartierScalarCompatibility [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface], with the specified normalized coefficient units, their unbounded derived universal properties, and their Ext square.

source.place: Paragraph 4: finite coefficient extension and its functoriality

proof.text: The integral supported constant has stalk Z on D and zero off D. Derived reduction and further extension therefore have the actual supported A-constant as source, with normalized unit 1↦1. The roots line is locally free over Z/n, so extension of its degree-zero complex is the ordinary tensor line, including for nonflat A→B.

source.place: Paragraph 4: finite coefficient extension and its functoriality

proof.text: The derived scalar adjunction gives the two universal properties against all unbounded complexes. Its transitivity comparison sends (x tensor a) tensor b to x tensor φ(a)b. It therefore preserves the required constant and pure-root normalizations. Naturality at the full pole boundary proves the coefficient square; the relative boundary uniqueness identifies its classes with the canonical ordinary ones.

source.place: Paragraph 4: finite coefficient extension and its functoriality

proof.text: Comparison inverse image commutes with derived scalar extension and its units. Apply it to that square and use the canonical supported mates to obtain the pro-etale Ext square. No flatness of the coefficient map is assumed. Zero coefficients and empty support give zero objects.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_scalar (A B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Finite A] [Finite B] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0)
    (hB : (n : B) = 0) (φ : A →+* B) {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) :
    GeoCartierScalarCompatibility φ n hA hB i
      (geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i hI hZ)
      (geoCartierCanonicalClass B n hn hB i hI hZ)
